tours.name: Add a Departure Reason
tours.description: Learn how to add a reason that HR can choose when an employee leaves the company, so that departures are recorded and reported consistently.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to add a reason that HR can choose when an employee leaves the company, so that departures are recorded and reported consistently.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: The reasons people leave are configured in the Employees app, so that every departure is recorded the same way.

description_i18n.en_US: The reasons people leave are configured in the Employees app, so that every departure is recorded the same way.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Employees app, such as departure reasons and work locations.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Employees app, such as departure reasons and work locations.

steps.title: Departure Reasons
steps.description: This list holds the reasons offered when an employee is archived, such as Fired, Resigned or Retired. Check it before adding a new one.

description_i18n.en_US: This list holds the reasons offered when an employee is archived, such as Fired, Resigned or Retired. Check it before adding a new one.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to add a line.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to add a line.

steps.description: The New button adds an empty line at the bottom of the list, ready to type in.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button adds an empty line at the bottom of the list, ready to type in.

steps.title: Name
steps.content: Type the name, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name, then press Tab.

steps.description: Use a short, clear name such as Contract ended or Relocation. The name appears in the Archive window and in reports.

description_i18n.en_US: Use a short, clear name such as Contract ended or Relocation. The name appears in the Archive window and in reports.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the line.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the line.

steps.description: The line is only stored once you save it. After saving it is available everywhere this list is used.

description_i18n.en_US: The line is only stored once you save it. After saving it is available everywhere this list is used.

steps.title: The list
steps.content: The new line is now part of the list. Click the column headings to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The new line is now part of the list. Click the column headings to finish.

steps.description: Lines can be edited later by clicking them, and removed or archived when they are no longer needed.

description_i18n.en_US: Lines can be edited later by clicking them, and removed or archived when they are no longer needed.
